map.由表面张力与曲率半径求球泡内外压差: Find the Pressure Difference Across a Spherical Bubble from Surface Tension and Radius of Curvature
map.输入表面张力 γ 与曲率半径 R，求内外压差。: Enter the surface tension γ and the radius of curvature R to find the pressure difference.
map.ΔP = 2γ/R（球形液膜为 4γ/R）。 水,R=1mm → 144 Pa。: ΔP = 2γ/R, or 4γ/R for a spherical liquid film. Water, R=1 mm → 144 Pa.
map.ΔP = 2γ/R（球形液膜为 4γ/R）。: ΔP = 2γ/R, or 4γ/R for a spherical liquid film.
map.算球泡内外压差: Compute the pressure difference across a bubble
map.Δp = 2γ/R（单界面球）；肥皂泡为双界面 Δp=4γ/R。: Δp = 2γ/R for a single spherical interface, while a soap bubble with two interfaces gives Δp=4γ/R.
map.Δp=2γ/R。例：水 γ=0.0728 N/m、曲率半径 R=1 mm，单界面: Δp=2γ/R. Example: water with γ=0.0728 N/m and a radius of curvature R=1 mm gives Δp=2×0.0728/0.001=145.6 Pa for a single interface; a soap bubble, with two interfaces, gives Δp=4×0.0728/0.001=291.2 Pa, so small bubbles carry a higher internal pressure.
map.同式，描述曲率引起的界面压差。: The same expression, describing the interfacial pressure difference caused by curvature.
map.R 小则 Δp 大，小泡内压高易并入大泡。: A smaller R gives a larger Δp, so small bubbles are at higher internal pressure and readily merge into larger ones.
